fact: 凡尔登战役自1916年2月21日持续至12月18日，是第一次世界大战中最长、最惨烈的战役之一；伤亡口径差异很大，大英百科全书给出法军约40万、德军约35万，卢布斯卡军事博物馆则称双方合计65万至75万（含阵亡、失踪与负伤）。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Battle of Verdun"
sources.quote: Battle of Verdun, (February 21–December 18, 1916), World War I engagement in which the French repulsed a major German offensive. It was one of the longest, bloodiest, and most-ferocious battles of the war; French casualties amounted to about 400,000, German ones to about 350,000. Some 300,000 were killed.

sources.title: Lubuskie Military Museum, "The Battle of Verdun, February–December 1916"
sources.quote: The ten-month-long, relentless Franco-German conflict claimed between 650,000 and 750,000 lives, including those killed, missing and wounded.

fact: 1916年2月25日杜奥蒙堡（Fort Douaumont）被德军占领，同日贝当接掌凡尔登防务；6月7日沃堡（Fort Vaux）在守军抵抗一周后陷落。至7月德军推进到苏维尔堡前，此后再未突破。

sources.title: Verdun Tourism (official), "The destroyed village of Fleury-devant-Douaumont"
sources.quote: On February 21, 1916, the battle of Verdun began. The village was awakened by artillery fire in preparation for the German assault. ... On 25 February the fort of Douaumont fell to the Germans, who now had a view of the bombed village. On 7 June, Fort de Vaux fell in turn.

sources.title: Lubuskie Military Museum, "The Battle of Verdun"
sources.quote: On 25 February, one of the most important strongholds of French resistance – Fort Douaumont – fell. This was a wake-up call. On the same day, General Ph. Pétain took command of all defensive operations.

fact: 索姆河攻势于1916年7月1日由英法联军发起，首日英军伤亡近6万人（约2万人阵亡），是英军史上最血腥的一天；战役至11月中旬结束，大英百科全书给出的总伤亡为德军65万、英军42万、法军19.5万，另有资料记为英军首日57,470人伤亡、德军总伤亡约44万。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, "First Battle of the Somme"
sources.quote: Nearly 60,000 British casualties (including 20,000 killed) occurred on the first day. ... The staggering losses included 650,000 German casualties, 420,000 British, and 195,000 French.

sources.title: 維基百科「索姆河戰役首日」條目（鏡像站 dreu.org 轉錄）
sources.quote: 這一天的時間點剛好就是第一次世界大戰的中間，也是英國陸軍史上最血腥的一天，因為有57470人的傷亡(其中有19240人陣亡或因傷死亡)

fact: 面包是法国战时少数价格几乎未变的商品，每公斤43至50生丁；1914年面粉与磨坊被征用，1916年起以“国家面包”（pain national）取代白面包，出粉率提高到80%—85%。国家面包的启用时间有1916年4月与1916年6月29日两种记载。

sources.title: 1914-1918-Online, "Food and Nutrition (France)"
sources.quote: Bread, one of the only commodities whose price remained practically unchanged throughout the conflict (at forty-three to fifty centimes per kilogram) was, in the French context, the ultimate test of the state's capacity to face food shortages. Stocks of flour and mills were requisitioned in 1914 and from April 1916, the "National Bread" replaced the white bread with a brown bread (extraction rate of 80 to 85 percent).

sources.title: "Paris in World War I"（維基百科條目鏡像 us-wikipedia.com）
sources.quote: A standard loaf of bread, called the pain national ("national bread"), was introduced on June 29, 1916; it was made with a more rustic flour than the traditional Parisian white loaf.

fact: 1916年5月起巴黎对糖按每公斤1.3法郎征税，对已大量替代黄油的人造黄油按每公斤2.70至3.10法郎征税；1916年国家对牛奶、糖、鸡蛋的价格与分配控制同步扩大。

sources.title: "Paris in World War I"（維基百科條目鏡像 us-wikipedia.com）
sources.quote: In May 1916, sugar was taxed at 1.3 francs per kilo, while margarine, which had largely replaced extremely-scarce butter, was taxed from 2.70 to 3.10 francs per kilo.

sources.title: "Paris in World War I"（鏡像）
sources.quote: A law of October 1915 allowed the state to requisition wheat and other grains at a price fixed by the government. In 1916, the controls were extended to milk, sugar and eggs.

fact: 法国自1915年10月立法授权国家按政府定价征购小麦与谷物，1916年将管制扩大到牛奶、糖、鸡蛋；巴黎对面包、糖、肉、烟草与煤炭实行配给与限价，主食短缺导致对贫民的免费配给。

sources.title: Paris 14-18（巴黎市政府“一战中的巴黎人日常生活”专题）
sources.quote: Shortages of staples triggered steep price increases, leading to the free distribution of rations of staples to the poor and rationing regulations for bread, sugar, meat, tobacco, and coal, and to control the costs of basic food items.

sources.title: "Paris in World War I"（鏡像）
sources.quote: As it became evident that the war would be long, the government began to take over the system of food distribution in the city.

fact: 法国1916年10月5日发行第二次“国防公债”：每100法郎面值发行价87.50法郎、名义利率5%、实收益率约5.71%，认购面值115.14亿法郎，净现金收入约100.82亿法郎；另有官方口径记为113.60亿法郎，两者统计基准不同。

sources.title: Federal Reserve Bulletin, "Movement of the French Public Debt"（FRASER 转录）
sources.quote: A second 5 per cent "rente" loan was issued in October, 1916, which, according to official announcement of the minister of finance on November 9, amounted to 11,360 million francs.

fact: 法国自1915年末开始研制雷诺 FT 轻型坦克，它是第一种采用可全向旋转炮塔、主炮装在炮塔内的坦克，成为此后坦克设计的基本范式；到1918年末产量超过3000辆。

sources.title: Imperial War Museums, "How did Britain develop the first tanks?"
sources.quote: France began development in late 1915, eventually creating the Renault FT light tank. This was the first to use a fully rotating turret that contained the tank's main armament - the basis of tank design ever since. Over 3,000 of these machines were made by late 1918.

fact: 凡尔登战役期间，法军在被德军炮火切断铁路后组织了史无前例的汽车运输：以3000余辆卡车经巴勒迪克至凡尔登57公里土路昼夜运送人员与物资，该路被称为“圣路”（La Voie Sacrée）。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Battle of Verdun"
sources.quote: French officers organized a motorized supply chain on an unprecedented scale, transporting men and matériel to the front in a fleet of more than 3,000 trucks. The 37-mile (57-km) dirt road connecting the railhead at Bar-le-Duc to Verdun came to be known as La Voie Sacrée ("the Sacred Way").
